customPorts.description: Steam query (UDP, same as the game port)
RCON (TCP, same as the game port)

editor.label: Server Config:
editor.description: The name of the configuration file to execute when the game server is started.

editor.label: Max FPS:
editor.description: Adjusts the frames per second that the server will process.

editor.label: Startup map
editor.description: The map the server starts on (nmo_ = objective, nms_ = survival). The map cycle continues from mapcycle.txt.

editor.label: Map time limit (minutes)
editor.description: Minutes before the server changes to the next map of the map cycle (0 = no limit).

editor.label: Realism mode
editor.description: No crosshair and no HUD hints, as in the menu option.

editor.label: Server-side Workshop maps
editor.description: Lets the server download Workshop maps (the Steam Workshop page of the panel uses it).

editor.label: Update Workshop maps on every map change
editor.description: The server always updates them when it starts.

editor.label: Join password
editor.description: Leave empty for a public server.

editor.label: RCON password
editor.description: Needed for the panel RCON and for rcon_password logins.

script.name: Prepare the server
script.description: Writes steam_appid.txt, keeps the previous console log, makes srcds executable and installs missing 32-bit libraries (apt, dnf or yum).

script.name: Add the Workshop map
script.description: Adds the Workshop map to the server (workshop_maps.txt and the map cycle). The server keeps it up to date and players download it from the Workshop.

script.name: Remove the Workshop map
script.description: Removes the Workshop map from workshop_maps.txt and the map cycle and deletes its files.
